lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2012 to assess acute food insecurity phases across Mali. Geographic data was compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON and KML formats) representing near-term food insecurity projections for January, April, July, and October 2012, with classifications indicating severity of food insecurity and assistance requirements.
